preservation.owned_addition: **中英生成理论链索引，2026年10月8日。** 按 [Ren 的范围与维护要求](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-bilingual-generativity-chain-index.md)，[持续维护的总表](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/GENERATIVITY-CHAIN.md)以所引共同形成论断为中心，列出62项根基、共同实现、伦理理由、学习／良知／智慧、形式支撑和来源入口。两种语言、状态、假设与相关页成对列出；[维护记录](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/GENERATIVITY-CHAIN-INDEX-RECORD.md)与来源版本检查支持研究后同步及每日有变化才更新。复用已有原文和总目录，未改写并行目录数据；索引整理不新增数学或伦理证明。

new_lines: **接续优先的完成尝试未取得新规范推论，2026年10月8日。** [损失比较续审 §8](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/GENERATIVE-LOSS-COMPARISON-INTEGRATION.md#8-接续优先的直接完成尝试尚未得到充分根据)直接检验接续相对有限完成的伦理分量，保留肯定解释、内容敏感对手及局部实践结束与全部生成结束的范围差别。新核读 Jonas 1973 原文 pp.42–45 未补上普遍根据，也不重计仓库已有目的能力审查。无新数学声明或编译；完整目标仍未完成，完成后独立 agent 验证待进行。本聊天将此记为上一轮实质进展后的第一次中心推论受阻，未标记完成或 blocked。

**损失比较的根据与范围，2026年10月8日。** [新整合](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/GENERATIVE-LOSS-COMPARISON-INTEGRATION.md)正面论证当下承受仍属于共同生成的伦理内容，检查已辩护混合比较在真实匹配减损／增损下的保持。Lean 4.29.1 通过 **16 项新定理／23 项声明审计**。损失敏感与传递性仍容许任何有限损失都让位于接续；这只定位弱规则的推理缺口，不反驳完整关系理论。K 的可反驳支持不自动成为全盘比较锚点。作者实质自审与 Sen 原文选段评估已整合；完整目标后的独立 agent 验证仍待进行。**下一连接：**接续关系相对有限完成的伦理分量、第一次混合比较与牺牲边界的正面根据。普遍规范目标未完成。

old_lines: **Living dependencies: maintenance derived from transport, 7 October 2026.** [Ren selects living dependencies as this conversation's current goal](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-living-dependencies-current-goal.md). [The integrated advance](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/LIVING-DEPENDENCY-INTEGRATION.md) derives the earlier support account from transport balance, a maintained operative bound and work-coupled export. Fresh Lean 4.29.1 passes **10 new theorems / 20 new declaration audits**, with 87 full-closure audits. Biological mechanism assessment, a persistent-component comparison, physical-source assessment and independent proof review are integrated. The result preserves inherited support, inactivity and depletion of an included provision store; it covers a specified nonnegative-net-transport regime, not all viability or stochastic histories. **Next connection:** signed passive transport and recoverable changes of realization, then wider living-domain correspondence. The [current formulation](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/LIVING-DEPENDENCIES.md) keeps the living goal active and other research intact.
new_lines: **Living dependencies: disturbed histories and renewed activity, 8 October 2026.** Under [Ren's current-goal directive](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-living-dependencies-current-goal.md), [the second integrated round](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/LIVING-DEPENDENCY-INTEGRATION.md#7-extension-passive-relief-and-actual-bounded-endpoints) removes the first transport model's nonnegative-net and every-state-bound restrictions. Passive relief, retained work and actual intermediate excursions enter a general necessary budget for a bounded endpoint. **15 new Lean theorems / 20 new declaration audits pass; 107 audits cover the full dependency closure.** Deeper reading of the same recovery assay and independent review distinguish nutrient-assisted repolarization plus resumed growth from restoration of a numerical amount or the old starvation regime. The prior 10-theorem maintained derivation remains unchanged. **Next connection:** retained or reconstructed organization enabling actual resumed activity, with wider living-domain coverage still open. The [current formulation](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/LIVING-DEPENDENCIES.md) preserves that scope and the active goal.

old_lines: **Living dependencies, 7 October 2026; current directed focus.** [The new formulation](unified-2026-10-05/LIVING-DEPENDENCIES.md) explains how actual transport and compensatory activity yield a maintained-condition dependency. [The integrated study](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/LIVING-DEPENDENCY-INTEGRATION.md) adds 10 checked Lean theorems, mechanistic primary evidence and independent review. Earlier formed support, dormant intervals, retained components and finite provision remain explicit. Signed transport, recoverable changes of regime and full living-domain coverage remain open; this does not assert new ethical authority.
new_lines: **Living dependencies, extended 8 October 2026; current directed focus.** [The current formulation](unified-2026-10-05/LIVING-DEPENDENCIES.md) connects transport and compensatory activity to maintained conditions, then follows actual excursions with passive transfer in both directions. [The integrated study](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/LIVING-DEPENDENCY-INTEGRATION.md#7-extension-passive-relief-and-actual-bounded-endpoints) adds 15 checked Lean theorems after the previous 10, alongside deeper recovery evidence and independent review. Passive relief, retained work and finite provision remain explicit. Amount restoration does not alone establish resumed living function; retained or reconstructed organization is the next connection. Full living-domain coverage and first ethical authority remain open.
